target.title: improve(matrix): generate executable QA route and state evidence
target.body:
Closes #100038
Related: #99707

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix QA scenarios exercised real client/server behavior but did not produce a redacted, executable description of the ordered route and state contract observed during each run. Maintainers had to interpret logs manually to compare Tuwunel and Crabline behavior across retries, errors, sync tokens, devices, keys, media, and room-key backups.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change places Tuwunel traffic behind a redacting request/response recorder, derives the versioned `matrix-qa-v1` manifest only from completed scenario traffic, and runs one differential probe unchanged against Tuwunel and Crabline. The manifest is generated dynamically rather than maintained as a checked-in baseline, and the implementation does not add a parallel live-runtime factory or import QA Lab internals.

This PR was developed with AI assistance.

## User Impact

Matrix QA maintainers can inspect per-scenario ordered routes, redacted request/response shapes, retry and terminal error sequences, principal-scoped sync-token progression, and device/key/media/backup expectations. There is no change to the user-facing Matrix plugin runtime.

## Evidence

- Focused recorder, fault-proxy, harness, and differential probe proof: 4 files, 30 tests passed.
- Full Matrix extension proof on the rebased head: 24 files, 231 tests passed with one worker.
- Fresh structured autoreview on head `5b555319d74ae544f467809c1f9540cfabe3938f`: no accepted/actionable findings (thread `019f2e37-8ff7-7df3-902a-3ac655357c42`).
- Exact-content `check:changed` passed on Blacksmith Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwq3jthqwp5ghzxpky4e56qe`, Actions run `28714415222`.
- Live profile collection completed for fast, transport, media, E2EE smoke, E2EE deep, and E2EE CLI profiles. Generated manifests validated for all specialized profiles.
- Existing scenario timeouts remained in three tool-progress transport scenarios and two generated-media/voice-preflight scenarios; all E2EE profiles passed completely.
